fe_snapshot_equivalence: NOT_ASSUMED; implementation uses the connected dev source_base_sha

query.warranty_case_id: optional real UUID; case_id is not accepted
query.status: optional DRAFT/RECORDED/CANCELLED; omitted includes DRAFT and RECORDED

read_requests.response: data[] private linked tasks; meta.total/status_totals/page/per_page/last_page/has_more/count_unit/included_statuses/scope. No canonical business list merge.
data is a persisted staging snapshot; ETag is its current draft version, never original UNKNOWN request version
P03 native outcome/receipt/historical response, data.document is current scoped P21 projection, p21_recovery_policy CHECK_ONLY, may_create_new_request false

headers.If-Match: Do not send on P21 reads; preserve original separately for owner SAVE or canonical operation evidence
headers.Idempotency-Key: Do not send on P21 reads; request identity is the operation_key path segment
headers.unsupported: Wrong header/query/body is422. Sending this read header on P03 PUT/cancel is422 before any write. Do not use it for P19 RECORD.
headers.legacy: Without the P21 header, existing P03 request/response and DRAFT-default list remain unchanged. Never silently fall back in a P21 production adapter.

permissions.read: (warranty.view OR warranty.manage) AND warranty.component_issue plus active actor/stable current-login auth session/confirmed ACTIVE warehouse and persisted case ownership
permissions.business_open: Additionally documents.read; owner P20 GET independently revalidates all permissions/warehouse/case/tenant
permissions.tenant: P09 trusted actor+warehouse dimensions and source column isolation, before SQL total. No client tenant overrides. No tenant columns means single-tenant database isolation is a deployment dependency, not a fabricated tenant.
permissions.privacy: Own persisted input form.p19/codes only, not canonical customer PII. Fetch masked customer/case data from P09. No other actor or login family can read this task. Cache-Control private,no-store; Vary X-Component-Resume-Contract.

list.included: Only P03 COMPONENT_ISSUE rows whose saved form.p19.contract is p19-component-issue-linked-v1 and case has persisted ownership in this warehouse. Closed cases are included.
list.excluded: Legacy business DRAFT/SCANNING documents, unlinked generic snapshots and foreign/unverified cases are not aliased or counted as P21 tasks.
list.status_totals: All3 native statuses within the same authorized linked source and optional case filter, before selected status filtering
list.sort: updated_at DESC,document_id DESC; SQL total, never data.length
list.consistency: LIVE_READ_NOT_FROZEN_CROSS_REQUEST; offset paging can shift with concurrent updates. Preserve IDs and metadata; deduplicate overlapping IDs and refresh explicitly, do not infer EOF from one page.
list.lost_first_save: A missing server task cannot erase a private pending checkpoint. Check the original SAVE UUID; UNKNOWN/null/404 do not prove the operation did not execute.

checkpoint.fields: codes preserve persisted raw_code/order/quantity/scan_source; form.p19 allowlist contract,warranty_case_id,document_date,note. No generated business line/scan-event IDs.
checkpoint.summary: UNVALIDATED_PERSONAL_SNAPSHOT; missing explicit quantity/source makes snapshot_shape_valid false and quantity_total null, never default1 or issued quantity
checkpoint.business: business_document_id/status/version/document_no/posted_at only after actual linked document passes read ACL. business_link_present true with unavailable business projection is a retained task requiring owner resolution, never permission to record again.
checkpoint.versions: ETag/data.version are current staging version. business_version is a separate current business version. last_receipt_version/receipt.version are historical request result versions.
checkpoint.last_command: Stored successful last_command helps navigate the last receipt only. It does not replace a different in-flight operation key/command from the private client checkpoint.
checkpoint.source_distinction: Local batch codes are not persisted business scan events; P20 provides historical raw/quantity evidence after Post. REMOVED/issued semantics are not fabricated from P03 codes.

resume_policy.OWNER_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED: Navigate back to the same P19 batch. This does not authorize immediate writing: unresolved local operations must be checked first, then owner resolve/validate and explicit user confirmation.
resume_policy.READ_ONLY_CASE_STATE: Case no longer CHECKING/REPAIRING; snapshot and receipts readable, writes remain blocked by P19. Never auto change case status.
resume_policy.READ_ONLY_INCOMPLETE_SNAPSHOT: Snapshot lacks explicit P19 fields; preserve data and seek owner clarification. No default quantity or replacement document.
resume_policy.READ_ONLY_LINK_CONFLICT: Staging state/business linkage inconsistent; no replacement RECORD.
resume_policy.READ_ONLY_CANCELLED: Historical cancelled staging only; no reactivation from P21.
resume_policy.OPEN_EXISTING_RESULT: Read the existing business ID through P20, never Post a second time.
resume_policy.RECORDED_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: Task is already RECORDED; missing permission/resource is partial/error, not empty or a new draft.

write_handoff.owner: P19 p19-component-issue-linked-v1 and P03 mini-app-p03-v1 unchanged
write_handoff.save: PUT existing draft UUID, operation COMPONENT_ISSUE, same scan UUID, complete snapshot; SAVE Idempotency-Key + strong If-Match. First save If-Match0, later saved draft version. Stock NONE.
write_handoff.resolve: Existing warranty-component-issues/resolve-code body warehouse_id/raw_code/warranty_case_id, no operation key/If-Match. Does not reserve stock.
write_handoff.record: Existing linked record, explicit post_immediately:true, P19 header, new RECORD key only for a new confirmed operation, X-Draft-ID/X-Draft-Scan-Session-ID/X-Draft-Version. No If-Match blanket. Exact snapshot metadata/codes/order/quantity. Business Post DECREASE atomically with P03 receipt.
write_handoff.cancel: Only explicit P03 owner action on confirmed DRAFT latest SAVE receipt/version; not exposed by P21 and never a fix for UNKNOWN.
write_handoff.canonical_gap: Canonical CREATE/SCANS/POST and standalone RECORD remain unsupported for automatic recovery. No dedicated GET result added. Existing writer replay does not prove read reconciliation. Do not create compensating documents or increase BOX quantity after lost responses.

recovery.check_only: S04 only the declared GET. UNKNOWN keeps original key/body/command/scan/draft/case/warehouse/actor/session/request version. No write retry, key rotation, cancel, new document or latest-version substitution.
recovery.historical: data.receipt and data.response belong to the exact earlier operation. data.document is current. SAVE success is not RECORD success; historical staging NONE is not the linked business Post effect.
recovery.http_trace: meta.request_id is trace Request-ID, NOT operation_key or scan_session_id
recovery.read_retry: Retry only the same GET query/path on transport failure; wrong scope/401/403 is not empty and is not retried under another login
recovery.no_negative_proof: No definitive NOT_EXECUTED/NOT_POSTED from DRAFT, missing row, null,404 or current POSTED. Current POSTED is not an operation receipt.

client_lifecycle.namespace: Private local checkpoint scoped by actor_id+auth_session_id+warehouse_id+operation+draft_id+scan_session_id; case_id alone is insufficient
client_lifecycle.pending_evidence: Keep original operation key/command/body fingerprint and request version independently from latest GET data. Never persist passwords/access/refresh tokens in the checkpoint.
client_lifecycle.refresh: P01 refresh retains stable login family; retain checkpoint identity and revalidate current scope
client_lifecycle.logout: P10 logout remains available; clear authentication for the correct family, not all business storage. Preserve private evidence without displaying/replaying it for another actor/session.
client_lifecycle.new_login: No automatic takeover even same actor/warehouse. New session cannot read old task/receipt; UNKNOWN is not recovery approval. Server-side family recovery policy remains owner-gated.
client_lifecycle.stale_response: Request generation + caller + actor/session/kho checks before applying callbacks. Back retains caller/scroll/raw inputs and UNKNOWN, no network mutation.
client_lifecycle.navigation: P09 canonical case, P19 owner edit/preflight, P20 history/detail, P23 owner routes only. Web URLs come from configured app routing, no invented production host.

errors.404: DRAFT_NOT_FOUND/RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND including out-of-scope case or checkpoint; not negative receipt

acceptance.ci: Run P21 and unchanged P03/P19/P20/warranty owner regressions on disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL plus route-cache P21 rerun; exact SHA, counts, failures and style separately. No fixture fallback in production.
remaining: BA/FE review of P03-linked mode and contract
owner concurrency/exactly-once UAT, no production stock tests without explicit authorization
acceptance.deployment: No new migration; P03 draft/receipt, P19 and persisted warranty owner schema must already exist. This source release does not replace the reported48c7f8fe DEV build until separately deployed.
